Package com.google.adk.agents

Class NodeViewAgent

java.lang.Object
com.google.adk.workflow.BaseNode
com.google.adk.agents.BaseAgent
com.google.adk.agents.NodeViewAgent
All Implemented Interfaces:
Node
@Experimental public final class NodeViewAgent extends BaseAgent
A read-only agent that stands in for a non-agent workflow node so code reading the agent of an app, runner, or invocation keeps working when they run a node. It never runs; the runner runs the node itself.
